subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: Should this issue remain a P0 satellite under the run-lifecycle umbrella, or should maintainers split a narrower Telegram ambiguous-send and poisoned-session recovery canonical issue?
rationale: Current main partially mitigates compaction timeouts, but the remaining behavior crosses lifecycle ownership, Telegram transport durability, and recovery UX, so automation cannot safely pick the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Keep as P0 satellite
options.body: Leave this issue open and linked to the lifecycle umbrella until end-to-end Telegram recovery proof closes the user-facing failure.

options.title: Split Telegram canonical
options.body: Move the unresolved Telegram unknown-send reconciliation and poisoned-session recovery work into a narrower canonical issue carrying the P0 impact labels.

options.title: Fold into lifecycle umbrella
options.body: Close this only if maintainers explicitly accept tracking the Telegram user-impact evidence solely through the broader lifecycle design issue.

recommendation.title: Keep as P0 satellite
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and linked to the lifecycle umbrella until end-to-end Telegram recovery proof closes the user-facing failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the referenced lifecycle umbrella where the abort, crash-resume, and completion-drive direction is being designed.
